title: Robot Kit Assembly Sequence
description: Six build steps to drag into order, each with the mechanical reason it has to come when it does.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Raspberry Pi Pico, MicroPython, and the Moving Rainbow Kit

educational.audience: Mentors preparing to run a build session

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a robot kit's loose parts, the learner sequences the assembly steps in the order that avoids blocking a later step, and explains why each step precedes the next.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Drag the cards into build order and check them; toggle the reasons
pedagogical.assessment: A correct order with the reason for each step said aloud.
